# Independent performance review — final test-only addendum

Verdict: **PASS for the frozen static scope**, maintaining round3. No blocking performance finding. Runtime is still unmeasured and tests remain unexecuted by this reviewer.

Current freeze: review-source-snapshot-round4.json, base ac58815bb268d338bea40a31fff630734cd719f4, worktree /workspace/android-studio-source-providers.

Current SHA-256 identities:

- Production generated_artifacts.rs: 5264e4c00d8958a4aaee250c7d924ae89e4665f778b893156442f6af3ed52be0
- Bridge project_model.gradle: 508ecc9987932f8d184983f551eca0cb1bc9efa6ed12806dcaff8a0a2f6880b7
- Tests generated_artifacts.rs: 9900069b1a993875795c4be1feadf5f4a8da2a5750f486beb4596ae6b45efbf1

Verified all 8 frozen source/data hashes and all 184 immutable original guards, then rechecked both before writing this addendum. Compared the round3 snapshot and hash-verified frozen round3 test source directly with current files. The only changed snapshot member is tests/generated_artifacts.rs, and its exact diff appends four lines for one additional malformed ArtifactSlot positional shape ["absent", null] at current tests:803–806. The prior ["absent"] case and all prior test assertions remain present. There are still 28 declared test functions; the shape regression now contains nine total subcases (one envelope and eight nested replacements).

The added fixture-sized malformed case incurs one more iteration of the existing regression loop only. No production algorithm, model query, allocation pattern, file path contract, UI/startup path, guard or wire limit changed. The linear module pairing, skipped unrelated Basic fields, 16 MiB predecode record limit and constant wrapper work per object remain the round3 static assessment. The test addition supplies no elapsed-time, memory or runtime proof.

Round3's advisory duplicate SDK queries, canonicalPath costs, potential future repeated ensure_current identity allocation and wire-limit-versus-RSS distinction are unchanged. Actual Cargo tests, strict repository Clippy/format checks, source-matched SDK probes and combined app/native/full-CI gates remain separate required evidence.

No Cargo, Gradle, app, benchmark, cache operation, source mutation or subagent spawn was performed. No original test, fixture, canonical matrix or protected branch was modified. Prior reports were preserved. Suggested .rules additions: none.
